resources.string: Shows a floating 🍚 bubble on top of Zerodha Kite. Turn it on and tap a holding, a watchlist stock or your Invested card to daydream: what if it moves, vs FD, what the profit buys. 🔒 Everything stays on this phone: it reads Kite\'s screen only while Kite is open, keeps no copy of your holdings, uploads nothing and never places orders. Internet is used only to download the optional on-device AI model. Not affiliated with Zerodha. Not investment advice.
